all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: agreement records, revisions and cascades re-derive their own hashes and identity forgery (a record id disagreeing with its own content) is refused by its own code

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: every niche and record in the fixtures is built through the sealed M05 builders, archive entries validate against their canonical schema, and authority schema names are resolved against the registry on every call

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: cross-surface agreement is surveyed completely rather than first-failure — every divergent pair is named in context — and staleness cascades list every derived record that must be rebuilt from a stale revision

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: a promotion request resting on a combined score, coverage ratio or entropy figure alone refuses PROMOTION_AUTHORITY_ABSENT in the EF4-I45 direction; a map figure may inform but never justify, and the actual decision is recorded as P-phase territory
